name: InuYasha
description: Headstrong, impulsive and fiercely protective of the people he cares about.

name: Kagome Higurashi
description: Compassionate, determined and able to remain calm even in difficult situations.

name: Sango
description: Brave, loyal and determined, with a strong sense of responsibility.

name: Miroku

name: Sesshomaru
